retreats.title: Energy Body Basic - A series
retreats.description:
Journey through the 7 Main Chakras of the energy body to connect with the innate wisdom of ourselves and bodies . Explore tools to empower this connection including vocal toning practices, guided visualization and meditation, as well as learning which crystals and essential oils correlate to which energy centers and how to use them.


Leave class with a recommended reading list and journal prompts to continue your exploration and practice at home.


This is a seven 1 hour long class series as each class will focus on one specific energy center at a time 2x a month.


The last class is 1.5 hours to allow us time to review and integrate all that we've learned and discovered during our time together.


Pre -register for the whole series or just one class. Class minimum attendance required Because this class is experiential there is a minimum of 5 participants required or cancellation - upon cancellation registrants will receive a full refund.


Package Deals- Pre-register for all seven classes for $150 Pre - register for all seven Classes with supplies kit included to take home ( crystals, essential oils, book) for $200 Pre-register- pay as you go 1 class purchase at a time $25 (except last class 1.5 hours $35
